steps.name: Install the pinned Android tools and API 36 x86_64 image
Enable KVM for this ephemeral runner
Install pinned Rust and the Android emulator target
Build x86_64 application and launcher APKs
Save successfully built native outputs before runtime verification
Verify native geometry, HOME, cold-Start unread badge, notification bootstrap/revocation and carrier call ownership

runtime_result.phase: Native geometry, Back, active HOME, cold-Start SMS badge, rendered notification bootstrap/revocation, restored access, incoming call ownership and MMS codec passed

repeat_receipt.message: This missed-call selection expired. Refresh the history and try again.

call_fixture.scope: The actual Android CallLog provider APIs executed on the owned fresh AVD. This fixture does not simulate a user tapping the Phone UI and initiated no RF call. The separate existing smoke phases exercised emulator SMS/Telecom traffic.

retained_intermediate_observations: The initial notification visibility probe found the fixture outside the visible viewport. One bounded native scroll revealed it; final rendered visibility and revocation checks passed. The pre-scroll observation and screenshot remain in the artifact.
cleanup_boundary: CallLog deletion and initial-row restoration are explicitly observed. HOME, dialer, SMS, listener access and user identity match their original observations. The full log records emulator shutdown and the workflow exits zero; this record does not independently inspect runner storage after AVD deletion.
